messages:
Jordan: Morning — quick async stand: drop 1-line status for your top deals + any security/compliance blockers. I’ll escalate infra asks after replies.

Mira: AstraHealth — demo scheduled for Thu. Legal asked for DPA + encryption-at-rest SLA. Customer insists on BYOK with HSM. Blocker: need confirmation we can support customer-managed keys in our Dedicated pilot.

Jordan: noted. @security-bot can you confirm BYOK/HSM support matrix for Dedicated vs Private?

security-bot: Automated check: BYOK/HSM available in Private (on-prem/VPC) + Dedicated with extra config. Deliverables: SOC2 + HSM key management checklist. ETA for package: EOD today.

Sam: KestrelCorp — stalled on network peering details. They want EU-only routing + IP allowlist. Blocker: we need concrete guidance for SAML vs OIDC preference and whether we support regional peering yet.

Olivia: NovaGrid — commercial approved, waiting on HSM policy language in the contract. Pushed a tiny CR to repo: `contracts/hsm-policy.md` (link in thread). Please review.

Alec: Skimmed the CR, two tiny wording nits around key-rotation TTLs. I can submit patch after stand.

Mira: Quick ops ask — AstraHealth asked about audit logs retention for 7 years. Is that on the table or do we propose 13 months + export?

Jordan: Default is 13 months, exportable longer for an add-on. @security-bot confirm export process?

security-bot: Export process: customer may configure long-term retention -> we provide S3-compatible export + signed manifest. Quick sample config:```yaml
export:
  enabled: true
  destination: s3://customer-export-bucket
  manifest_signed: true
  retention_policy: customer-defined
```

deploy-bot: Staging env for AstraHealth provisioned: https://staging.redwood.example/a/astrachealth — creds emailed to SE.

Sam: Action items for me: 1) follow up on peering doc with infra, 2) draft EU-data-residency addendum template, 3) ping product about SAML/OIDC parity.

Olivia: Action items: 1) merge contract CR after Alec patch, 2) confirm billing start date with finance, 3) prep onboarding checklist.

Mira: Action items: 1) send AstraHealth list of required security artifacts to Legal & Security, 2) confirm demo scope.

Jordan: Thanks. If anyone needs me to escalate to Eng Infra for faster turn, react :rocket: or ping me directly. Otherwise we’ll sync tomorrow if blockers persist.

Alec: +1 will push patch by 10:30 PT. :thumbsup:
